Webhook.label: WhatsApp message in
Webhook.desc: Twilio forwards every incoming WhatsApp message from a lead to this webhook — this is what starts the workflow.

Respond to Webhook.label: Acknowledge Twilio
Respond to Webhook.desc: Replies to Twilio instantly, so the request never times out while the AI is still thinking.

Extract Fields.label: Extract lead details
Extract Fields.desc: Pulls the lead's phone number, WhatsApp name and message text out of the incoming payload.

AI Agent.label: AI qualification agent
AI Agent.desc: Has a natural conversation and asks one question at a time: buy or rent, area, budget, timeline and financing. Retries automatically up to 3 times if the model fails.

Google Gemini Chat Model.label: Gemini
Google Gemini Chat Model.desc: The language model that powers the agent's replies.

Simple Memory.label: Conversation memory
Simple Memory.desc: Remembers each lead's chat history, keyed by their phone number, so the bot never asks the same question twice.

Code in JavaScript.label: Parse & score lead
Code in JavaScript.desc: Reads the agent's reply, extracts the collected answers as structured data, and scores the lead HOT / WARM / COLD using budget and timeline rules.

Send an SMS/MMS/WhatsApp message.label: Reply to lead
Send an SMS/MMS/WhatsApp message.desc: Sends the agent's reply back to the lead on WhatsApp — usually within about 10 seconds.

If.label: Qualified?
If.desc: Continues only once all the qualifying answers have been collected.

Append or update row in sheet.label: Save lead
Append or update row in sheet.desc: Adds the lead to the Leads sheet (or updates their row, matched by phone number) with every answer, the score and status.

If1.label: HOT lead?
If1.desc: Checks whether the lead scored HOT.

Send an SMS/MMS/WhatsApp message2.label: Alert the agent
Send an SMS/MMS/WhatsApp message2.desc: Instantly sends the agent a 🔥 HOT LEAD message with the lead's name, area, budget and timeline.

Send an SMS/MMS/WhatsApp message1.label: Fallback reply
Send an SMS/MMS/WhatsApp message1.desc: If the AI fails even after retries, the lead still gets a polite “give me a moment” message instead of silence.
